final: {"prompt": "A square abstract painting that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. It is purely nonrepresentational, with no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The palette is deep ultramarine and blackened indigo, set against a few sharp slashes of hot vermilion and a pale, cold lemon-white. Smaller touches of oxidized teal and ash grey sit in between. The left two thirds is dense and layered. Thick impasto strokes are dragged and scraped over each other in heavy, restless diagonals. Translucent glazes lie under opaque knife-work, and rough dry-brush edges catch the underlayers. The brushwork is urgent and gestural, with rhythmic bursts of short stabbing marks that build into a pulse and then break off abruptly. A narrow vertical rift of raw, thinly washed pale space cuts through the right of center. It is almost empty, with faint drips and a single soft, hesitant smear. It holds spatial tension against the crowded mass beside it. On the far right the density gathers again as a quiet, slow field of smoky grey-blue with subtle scumbled texture. The vermilion appears only in a few concentrated places, each one a point of friction where contrast peaks. Heavy tactile surface, visible bristle marks, cracked paint ridges, and a sense of pressure and release across the whole composition."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
